steps: Create a project from the generated source package as the operator.
Verify the package; repeat in fresh projects with one source unavailable and one altered.
assertions: The valid package records source identity, permitted location, verification state and actor.
Absent, withdrawn or altered sources are refused for processing; inspect attributed verification results.

steps: Review both authorised fixture assets and their supplied transcripts.
Save and freeze the fixture's ordered selection as the editor.
Start a new client session and recover the exact saved revision through the public interface.
assertions: Each selected segment still identifies its source and interval in the declared order.
The recovered revision preserves author, creation time, content and input references.

steps: Attempt export from an unfrozen selection.
Freeze the reference selection and request one supported export format.
Inspect the public export package and its verification record.
assertions: The unfrozen export is refused.
The successful export names the exact frozen revision, referenced inputs and output files.
Format, known limitations and verification/recipient-recipe status are explicit.
No compatibility claim appears for a recipient environment without a recorded recipe.

steps: Launch a declared processing capability with identified inputs and versioned parameters.
In isolated attempts, trigger a processing failure, cancellation and indeterminate outcome using the declared test fault boundary.
Inspect run records and attempt to use each resulting artifact as validated matter or export input.
assertions: Each attempt retains initiator, inputs, parameters, real terminal state and reason.
Non-success artifacts are never presented as validated or eligible for export.
The successful control records its result identities and terminal state.

steps: Use a profile with external services disabled by default and start a fixture-scoped destination monitor.
Attempt activation/transmission without policy, with missing authorisation and with a missing declared dependency.
Inspect the denial and continue the independent selection/export path.
assertions: No fixture canary reaches the monitored destination on a denied attempt.
The reason and initiating actor are observable; independent core operations stay usable.
If external activation is supported, destination, data categories and authorising policy are visible before activation.

cases.applicability: Two declared deployment profiles are available. Otherwise report not_run and withhold the cross-profile claim.
steps: Inspect each profile's capabilities, dependencies, data locations, execution limits and replay procedure.
Run the core reference journey on both profiles at the same immutable candidate revision.
Compare normalised domain states and provenance relations.
assertions: Profile identity and version are present in each evidence record.
Both journeys agree on source/segment order and provenance, ignoring profile-specific paths, clocks and generated identifiers.
A profile cannot claim verification before its applicable scenarios have execution evidence.

cases.applicability: Contextual review is offered. Otherwise report not_run and do not claim this should capability.
steps: Publish an editor note on asset-b at the fixture timestamp.
Compare assets and publish a second note on the other asset.
Recover both notes and their public references.
assertions: Every published note has an author and an unambiguous asset, timestamp or selection reference.
Comparison never silently moves a note to the other asset.

steps: Record byte digests of both disposable source assets.
Complete processing, selection and export operations.
Compare source bytes with the initial digests; separately withdraw a source and retry processing.
assertions: All original source digests remain unchanged.
A withdrawn source is refused for new processing.

steps: If assistance is offered, request a proposal and inspect whether it remains a proposal.
Attempt automatic freeze/remittance without an attributed authorised-editor action.
Perform a control freeze/remittance as the editor.
assertions: An assistance proposal alone cannot freeze a selection or remit an export.
The control action records its editor attribution.
Without assistance support, inspect the core freeze/remittance path and retain its attribution evidence.

cases.applicability: A local profile is offered. Otherwise report not_run and withhold the local portability claim.
steps: Provision the declared local profile under a fresh path without the developer's personal directories or symbolic links.
Execute the core reference journey and recover the selection through the documented persistence/export path.
assertions: The journey does not depend on a personal path or an unchecked symbolic link.
Selection state is recoverable/exportable independently of one browser session.

steps: Start the reference profile with optional scoring, stock-footage and assistance services disabled.
Review supplied transcripts/media, persist a selection and generate an export.
assertions: The core journey remains usable without an unauthorised external account.
Optional assistance does not redefine core provenance and source-integrity guarantees.

steps: Collect the profile operations guide, reference manifest, scenario reports and recipient-recipe sheet from the candidate release.
Check them against the same target revision and contract lock.
assertions: Replay instructions and sanitised artifact digests are supplied per declared profile.
Planned/blocked/not_run cases do not become passing evidence.
Compatibility remains unverified without a recipient recipe.
